findings.evidenceJa: 後悔も希望も感じさせない幽鬼のまま

findings.evidenceJa: だがおまえの体は

findings.evidenceJa: 正規のマスター

findings.evidenceJa: 今までの比ではなかった

findings.evidenceJa: 不快げに舌打ちし

findings.evidenceJa: 赤い弾丸と化して
findings.governingReading: becoming a red bullet

findings.highlight: attacks her with all his might

findings.explanation: The pressure forcing Archer backward disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 予想より早くついた

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの剣舞

findings.evidenceJa: 必殺の一撃

findings.explanation: The decisive lethality of Saber’s finishing strike disappears.

findings.governingReading: cleave him in two from the forehead down
findings.explanation: A full-body bisection is narrowed to damage to the head.

findings.evidenceJa: 呼吸は千々に乱れている

findings.evidenceJa: ここまでですアーチャー
findings.governingReading: This is as far as you go, Archer.

findings.explanation: A technical description of the Master’s metaphysical function is reduced to the role label.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔力の供給もままならない
findings.governingReading: cannot obtain an adequate supply of magical energy

findings.highlight: ability to remain even after the Master is gone

findings.evidenceJa: ふそれこそ
findings.governingReading: Hah—that
findings.explanation: A missing separator fuses Archer’s laugh into the next word.

findings.evidenceJa: 苦悩に歪むセイバーの顔
findings.governingReading: Saber’s face, contorted with anguish
findings.explanation: Saber’s visible anguish and facial distortion disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 何故何故
findings.governingReading: Why—why
findings.explanation: A missing separator fuses Saber’s repeated question.

findings.evidenceJa: 間違った望み

findings.evidenceJa: 一瞬、昏い目をして

findings.evidenceJa: 今回ではないようだがおそらくは
findings.governingReading: this time, but I will probably
findings.explanation: A missing separator fuses “time” and “and.”

findings.evidenceJa: 聖堂
findings.governingReading: sanctuary of the church
findings.explanation: The Christian setting is again mislabeled as a temple.

findings.evidenceJa: あくまで次の話
findings.governingReading: that belongs to the next occasion
findings.explanation: Sequence is changed into an unsupported assertion of temporal distance.

findings.highlight: I will not hold back against you even in this world

findings.governingReading: this world will spare no one who obstructs it, not even you

findings.evidenceJa: 阻むのならばこの世界は
findings.governingReading: stop me, this world will

findings.governingReading: clearly gives voice to words of power
findings.explanation: The magically efficacious 言霊 are reduced to ordinary speech.

findings.evidenceJa: 聖堂
findings.governingReading: sanctuary of the church
findings.explanation: The Christian location is again mislabeled as a temple during the Reality Marble transition.

findings.evidenceJa: 頭痛が、思考を埋め尽くす
findings.governingReading: The headache engulfs all thought

findings.evidenceJa: この異常

findings.evidenceJa: 製鉄場
findings.governingReading: an ironworks or forge
findings.explanation: The interior image becomes redundant modern industrial terminology.

findings.evidenceJa: 担い手のない剣

findings.evidenceJa: この世界より編み出されたもの

findings.evidenceJa: 廃棄場じみている
findings.governingReading: resembles a dumping ground
findings.explanation: The coined “wasteyard” produces conspicuously unnatural English.

findings.highlight: puts form to the user’s mind

findings.governingReading: reproduce and store a weapon merely by seeing its original

findings.evidenceJa: 真に迫る事はできる

findings.highlight: Do not use your holy sword

findings.highlight: You should not die instantly if you are lucky

findings.governingReading: If you are lucky, you may avoid dying instantly
findings.explanation: A grim possibility is recast as a normative expectation.

findings.highlight: I have jumped up, run to Saber

findings.governingReading: the eighteen swords flying in every direction

findings.evidenceJa: 次が迫る
findings.governingReading: The next one closes in
findings.explanation: The sequential arrival of the next sword becomes simultaneous plural motion.

findings.highlight: Something like a cocking hammer goes down in my head

findings.governingReading: If that principle and those laws are sound
findings.explanation: Two governing components of projection are collapsed into generic theory.

findings.evidenceJa: てんじゃねえ、テメェ
findings.governingReading: Don’t screw with me, you bastard
findings.explanation: Shirou’s furious challenge becomes an ungrammatical command to be ridiculous.

findings.evidenceJa: 忌々しげに俺を睨んだ

findings.explanation: Archer’s frustrated resentment at Shirou’s interference is changed into revulsion.

findings.evidenceJa: 聖堂を後にする
findings.governingReading: leaves the church sanctuary
findings.explanation: The Christian location is again mislabeled as a temple.

findings.highlight: I do not have enough power to defeat both of you

findings.governingReading: she is a bargaining condition; as long as I hold this leverage
findings.explanation: Rin’s function as the condition securing Shirou’s pursuit becomes the unnatural claim that she herself is an exchange.

findings.evidenceJa: 倒れそうな意識を絞って
findings.governingReading: I rally the consciousness that threatens to collapse
findings.explanation: Shirou’s failing consciousness becomes a mind performing an unnatural action.

findings.highlight: I say so with a shaking throat, not even able to look up
findings.evidenceJa: 震える喉で、見上げる事もできないまま言い放った
findings.governingReading: Unable even to look up, I forcefully declare it through my trembling throat

findings.evidenceJa: 使われていない城
findings.governingReading: a castle that is not in use

findings.evidenceJa: それだけを口にした

findings.evidenceJa: いい覚悟じゃないか
findings.governingReading: that is admirable resolve

findings.highlight: I don’t want to hear meaningless things

findings.governingReading: I don’t want to hear your glib banter

findings.highlight: I won’t be able to hold this nausea in and I might vomit out my organs

findings.governingReading: I will lose control and spill the organs inside my body

findings.evidenceJa: ぎり、と

findings.highlight: scratch my forehead, tearing off the skin

findings.governingReading: rake my forehead and its skin with my nails

findings.governingReading: after pushing yourself so recklessly, it is too soon for you

findings.governingReading: Even for you, it is far too soon to perform the same projection as Archer

findings.evidenceJa: 軋む頭蓋を押さえて
findings.governingReading: clutching my creaking skull
findings.explanation: The physical sensation of Shirou’s skull grinding is reduced to a generic headache.
